vocab.definition: to be on fire
vocab.example: The paper is burning.
vocab.cn_example: 纸在燃烧。

vocab.definition: to give something and get something at the same time
vocab.example: The gentlemen exchange phone numbers.
vocab.cn_example: 先生们交换了电话号码。

vocab.definition: to make a person known to another person
vocab.example: Jane’s husband introduces her to his handsome friend.
vocab.cn_example: 简的丈夫把她介绍给他英俊的朋友。

vocab.definition: to try to give or do something to help someone
vocab.example: Paul offered the man money, but he was not interested.
vocab.cn_example: 保罗主动给那个男人钱，但他不感兴趣。

vocab.definition: to forgive, often used with me
vocab.example: “Pardon me. Can you tell me how to get to the subway?”
vocab.cn_example: “打扰一下。你能告诉我怎么去地铁吗？”

vocab.definition: liked by many people
vocab.example: This busy street is a popular place to shop.
vocab.cn_example: 这条繁忙的街道是受欢迎的购物地点。

vocab.definition: to make
vocab.example: The cooks prepare a delicious meal in the restaurant.
vocab.cn_example: 厨师们在餐厅里准备一顿美味的饭菜。

vocab.definition: something that says why something was or was not done
vocab.example: He did not have a reason for arriving late at the theater.
vocab.cn_example: 他没有理由迟到剧院。

vocab.definition: to hold and move up and down
vocab.example: The woman shakes Sue’s hand and congratulates her.
vocab.cn_example: 那个女人握住苏的手祝贺她。

vocab.definition: quiet and not wanting to talk to others
vocab.example: The young boy is very shy.
vocab.cn_example: 那个小男孩非常害羞。

vocab.definition: something that makes a ringing sound when hit
vocab.example: The bell rings when the gate opens.
vocab.cn_example: 大门打开时铃响了。

vocab.definition: a part of a city with streets on all four sides
vocab.example: There are many houses on each block.
vocab.cn_example: 每个街区都有很多房子。

vocab.definition: to take and use something belonging to another person
vocab.example: Thank you for letting me borrow your math book this week.
vocab.cn_example: 谢谢你这周借给我你的数学书。

vocab.definition: a dish with tall sides
vocab.example: I had a big bowl of soup for lunch.
vocab.cn_example: 我午餐喝了一大碗汤。

vocab.definition: to make it difficult for someone to understand
vocab.example: Math confuses Scott.
vocab.cn_example: 数学让斯科特感到困惑。

vocab.definition: to hit something with part of your hand
vocab.example: She continued to knock on the door.
vocab.cn_example: 她继续敲门。

vocab.definition: an exam grade; something that is caused by another
vocab.example: John’s doctor was very happy with his test results.
vocab.cn_example: 约翰的医生对他的检查结果非常满意。

vocab.definition: to look to be
vocab.example: They seem to be enjoying the funny movie tonight.
vocab.cn_example: 他们似乎很享受今晚这部有趣的电影。

vocab.definition: good at learning or thinking about things
vocab.example: Chris is a very smart boy.
vocab.cn_example: 克里斯是一个非常聪明的男孩。

vocab.definition: something you study in school
vocab.example: English is the most popular subject at my school.
vocab.cn_example: 英语是我们学校最受欢迎的学科。

vocab.definition: doing many things
vocab.example: Children are very active and like to run and jump.
vocab.cn_example: 孩子们非常活跃，喜欢跑和跳。

vocab.definition: to think that something is true
vocab.example: He believes he is a smart boy.
vocab.cn_example: 他相信自己是个聪明的男孩。

vocab.definition: all of the things found in an area, indoors or outdoors
vocab.example: Fresh air is a good reason to live in a clean environment.
vocab.cn_example: 新鲜空气是住在清洁环境中的一个好理由。

vocab.definition: a big area of trees
vocab.example: The forest seems to be burning.
vocab.cn_example: 森林似乎在燃烧。

vocab.definition: a person
vocab.example: The old bridge was built by humans a long time ago.
vocab.cn_example: 这座老桥是很久以前由人类建造的。

vocab.definition: to look for animals to kill
vocab.example: Some people in North America like to hunt.
vocab.cn_example: 北美的一些人喜欢狩猎。

vocab.definition: a way to go from one place to another
vocab.example: Both paths take you to the gate of the park.
vocab.cn_example: 两条小路都能带你到公园的大门。

vocab.definition: not dangerous
vocab.example: The gentleman stands in a safe place away from the subway.
vocab.cn_example: 那位先生站在远离地铁的安全地方。

vocab.definition: the job of helping visitors at a place like a restaurant
vocab.example: The new restaurant has delicious food and great service.
vocab.cn_example: 这家新餐厅有美味的食物和优质的服务。

vocab.definition: living or growing without humans’ help
vocab.example: Africa is a popular place to see wild animals.
vocab.cn_example: 非洲是观赏野生动物的热门地方。

vocab.definition: a part of a larger place
vocab.example: The people living in this area are very poor.
vocab.cn_example: 住在这个区域的人非常贫穷。

vocab.definition: something you can choose
vocab.example: It is your choice. Do you want to go north or south?
vocab.cn_example: 这是你的选择。你想往北还是往南？

vocab.definition: to go in
vocab.example: She enters through the front gate.
vocab.cn_example: 她从前门进入。

vocab.definition: having great meaning
vocab.example: The king is the most important piece in the game.
vocab.cn_example: 国王是游戏中最重要的棋子。

vocab.definition: to be on your back on the ground or in a bed
vocab.example: She lies in the grass and looks up at the sky.
vocab.cn_example: 她躺在草地上仰望天空。

vocab.definition: angry
vocab.example: The woman is mad because someone hit her car.
vocab.cn_example: 那个女人很生气，因为有人撞了她的车。

vocab.definition: everything in the world that is not made by humans
vocab.example: She likes to take pictures of nature.
vocab.cn_example: 她喜欢拍摄大自然的照片。

vocab.definition: to keep safe from harm
vocab.example: The umbrella protects the people from the hot sun.
vocab.cn_example: 雨伞保护人们免受烈日的伤害。

vocab.definition: to say something very loudly
vocab.example: The shy boy surprised everyone by shouting.
vocab.cn_example: 那个害羞的男孩大喊一声，让所有人都吃了一惊。

vocab.definition: most of the time
vocab.example: People usually shake hands when they introduce themselves.
vocab.cn_example: 人们在自我介绍时通常会握手。

vocab.definition: causing great surprise or wonder
vocab.example: It is amazing that humans walked on the moon.
vocab.cn_example: 人类登上月球真是令人惊奇。

vocab.definition: to go to a class or activity
vocab.example: Many students attend this class on protecting the environment.
vocab.cn_example: 许多学生参加这门关于保护环境的课。

vocab.definition: a special, planned activity
vocab.example: There is usually a fun event at the park on a holiday.
vocab.cn_example: 假日时公园里通常会有有趣的活动。

vocab.definition: to say, write, or show thoughts or feelings
vocab.example: Marcy expresses her feelings with her face.
vocab.cn_example: 玛西用面部表情表达她的感受。

vocab.definition: a level of study in school
vocab.example: Lesley started first grade today.
vocab.cn_example: 莱斯利今天开始上一年级了。

vocab.definition: a piece; some but not all
vocab.example: The cheese was cut into eight parts.
vocab.cn_example: 奶酪被切成了八份。

vocab.definition: to keep something to use later
vocab.example: She is saving this cake to eat tomorrow.
vocab.cn_example: 她把这块蛋糕留着明天吃。

vocab.definition: to choose something
vocab.example: We need to set a date for our trip.
vocab.cn_example: 我们需要为旅行设定一个日期。

vocab.definition: an empty area where a person or thing can go
vocab.example: Their new apartment has a lot of space.
vocab.cn_example: 他们的新公寓有很大的空间。

vocab.definition: different from the usual
vocab.example: The store is offering special, low prices all week.
vocab.cn_example: 这家商店整周都在提供特别的低价。

vocab.definition: to shout to show happiness or to make others feel good
vocab.example: The fans are cheering for their favorite baseball team.
vocab.cn_example: 球迷们正在为他们最喜欢的棒球队欢呼。

vocab.definition: an event in which there is a winner
vocab.example: Mila and Victor won the dance contest!
vocab.cn_example: 米拉和维克多赢得了舞蹈比赛！

vocab.definition: something given to someone
vocab.example: His gift came in a pretty red box.
vocab.cn_example: 他的礼物装在一个漂亮的红色盒子里。

vocab.definition: a thin book that comes out once a week or month
vocab.example: “The Week” is my favorite news magazine.
vocab.cn_example: 《一周》是我最喜欢的新闻杂志。

vocab.definition: to do something like singing or acting in front of people
vocab.example: The popular singer performs all over the world.
vocab.cn_example: 这位受欢迎的歌手在世界各地表演。

vocab.definition: (after in) a place where many people can see you
vocab.example: Shy people do not like to speak in public.
vocab.cn_example: 害羞的人不喜欢在公共场合说话。

vocab.definition: a part of a play or movie
vocab.example: The scene with the fight is the most exciting part of the play.
vocab.cn_example: 打斗的场景是这部剧中最激动人心的部分。

vocab.definition: something that is kept hidden from other people
vocab.example: Greg is telling Jessica a secret. I wonder what it is!
vocab.cn_example: 格雷格在告诉杰西卡一个秘密。我想知道是什么！

vocab.definition: the part of a theater where people perform
vocab.example: Many great actors have performed on this stage.
vocab.cn_example: 许多伟大的演员曾在这个舞台上表演过。

vocab.definition: not like anyone or anything else
vocab.example: That man’s hair is unique.
vocab.cn_example: 那个男人的头发很独特。

vocab.definition: something used to give light and make things work
vocab.example: Humans use a lot of electricity.
vocab.cn_example: 人类使用大量的电。

vocab.definition: something that is true
vocab.example: South Korea is a country in Asia. That is a fact.
vocab.cn_example: 韩国是亚洲的一个国家。这是事实。

vocab.definition: to bend one part of something over another part
vocab.example: She folds her clothes to make more space for them.
vocab.cn_example: 她折叠衣服以便腾出更多空间。

vocab.definition: an object used to lock or unlock a door or to start a car
vocab.example: I usually keep my house key in a secret place.
vocab.cn_example: 我通常把房子钥匙放在一个秘密的地方。

vocab.definition: to be unhappy about something, usually used with not
vocab.example: She does not mind if you borrow her car.
vocab.cn_example: 她不介意你借她的车。

vocab.definition: something you cannot see that is used to make things work
vocab.example: They turned the power off for a special event.
vocab.cn_example: 他们为一个特别的活动关闭了电源。

vocab.definition: a soft piece of clothing that covers the foot
vocab.example: Jessica gave Holly socks for her birthday.
vocab.cn_example: 杰西卡送霍莉袜子作为生日礼物。

vocab.definition: to find the answer
vocab.example: He has to choose the correct path to solve the puzzle.
vocab.cn_example: 他必须选择正确的路径来解决谜题。

vocab.definition: to attach to something
vocab.example: Marsha sticks special notes on the door for her husband.
vocab.cn_example: 玛莎在门上为丈夫贴了特别的便条。

vocab.definition: cars on the road
vocab.example: It is not safe to drive in this area. There is too much traffic.
vocab.cn_example: 在这个区域开车不安全。交通太拥挤了。

vocab.definition: an opinion about what someone should or should not do
vocab.example: He gives them advice about saving money.
vocab.cn_example: 他给他们关于省钱方面的建议。

vocab.definition: a small box or bag
vocab.example: Max will buy a larger pencil case when he is in the sixth grade.
vocab.cn_example: 马克斯上六年级时会买一个更大的铅笔盒。

vocab.definition: a test
vocab.example: He takes an exam to attend the new school.
vocab.cn_example: 他参加考试以进入新学校。

vocab.definition: to take place
vocab.example: The car crash happened in front of the theater.
vocab.cn_example: 车祸发生在剧院前面。

vocab.definition: not wanting to work or move
vocab.example: John is smart, but he is very lazy.
vocab.cn_example: 约翰很聪明，但他非常懒惰。

vocab.definition: information that is sent or given to someone
vocab.example: Gary received an important message last night.
vocab.cn_example: 加里昨晚收到了一条重要的消息。

vocab.definition: dumb; foolish
vocab.example: Riding down the rocks in the toy car is a stupid idea.
vocab.cn_example: 坐玩具车从岩石上冲下去是个愚蠢的主意。

vocab.definition: to do well; to do what you tried to do
vocab.example: Pam’s family is happy that she succeeded in school.
vocab.cn_example: 帕姆的家人为她在学业上取得成功而高兴。

vocab.definition: very bad
vocab.example: Dan got a terrible grade on his exam.
vocab.cn_example: 丹考试得了很糟糕的成绩。

vocab.definition: worried; not happy
vocab.example: She is upset because she cannot find the book she needs.
vocab.cn_example: 她很心烦，因为她找不到需要的书。

vocab.definition: a flying machine
vocab.example: The airplane flies through the sky.
vocab.cn_example: 飞机在天空中飞行。

vocab.definition: a place where airplanes arrive and leave
vocab.example: The airplane arrived at the airport early.
vocab.cn_example: 飞机早到了机场。

vocab.definition: the way of life of a group of people
vocab.example: Melissa went to Japan to learn about its unique culture.
vocab.cn_example: 梅丽莎去了日本，了解其独特的文化。

vocab.definition: to make a choice
vocab.example: She decided to wear the blue shirt to the event.
vocab.cn_example: 她决定穿蓝色衬衫去参加活动。

vocab.definition: to go away from
vocab.example: They are leaving their office to go home.
vocab.cn_example: 他们正离开办公室回家。

vocab.definition: of the latest kind
vocab.example: I saw Jeff’s modern house in a magazine.
vocab.cn_example: 我在一本杂志上看到了杰夫的现代风格房子。

vocab.definition: to ask for food or drink at a restaurant
vocab.example: They took the waiter’s advice and ordered fish for dinner.
vocab.cn_example: 他们听从了服务员的建议，晚餐点了鱼。

vocab.definition: very tiny pieces of rock
vocab.example: Olivia wrote a message in the sand.
vocab.cn_example: 奥利维亚在沙子上写了一条消息。

vocab.definition: an area, place, or location
vocab.example: The beach is a popular spot in the summer.
vocab.cn_example: 海滩是夏天热门的地点。

vocab.definition: different from what is usual
vocab.example: The strange animal looks like it is dancing.
vocab.cn_example: 那只奇怪的动物看起来像在跳舞。

vocab.definition: a piece of paper money
vocab.example: Josh folds the bills before he puts them in his pocket.
vocab.cn_example: 乔希把纸币折好后再放进口袋。

vocab.definition: to move something with air
vocab.example: Kerri blows the seeds into the air.
vocab.cn_example: 凯丽把种子吹到空中。

vocab.definition: one hundred years
vocab.example: Bob was born one century ago.
vocab.cn_example: 鲍勃出生在一个世纪前。

vocab.definition: the usual way of doing something in a culture
vocab.example: It is a custom in many countries to give birthday gifts.
vocab.cn_example: 在许多国家，送生日礼物是一种习俗。

vocab.definition: to see, feel, or do something
vocab.example: They want to experience sleeping in nature.
vocab.cn_example: 他们想体验在自然中睡觉。

vocab.definition: happening in or between two or more countries
vocab.example: Many people attended the international meeting.
vocab.cn_example: 许多人参加了国际会议。

vocab.definition: a piece of land in the middle of water
vocab.example: There is no electricity on the island.
vocab.cn_example: 岛上没有电。

vocab.definition: a long trip
vocab.example: They are going on a journey through the sand.
vocab.cn_example: 他们正在穿越沙地的旅程中。

vocab.definition: food that is prepared and eaten
vocab.example: She made a terrible meal. No one liked it.
vocab.cn_example: 她做了一顿糟糕的饭。没有人喜欢。

vocab.definition: to come back after being away
vocab.example: We are always happy to return home.
vocab.cn_example: 我们总是很高兴回家。

vocab.definition: in fact
vocab.example: Actually, we do not mind waiting for you at the airport.
vocab.cn_example: 实际上，我们不介意在机场等你。

vocab.definition: to sleep outside in a tent
vocab.example: They camped on an island.
vocab.cn_example: 他们在岛上露营。

vocab.definition: to bring things together into one group
vocab.example: She collects shells that she finds in the sand.
vocab.cn_example: 她收集在沙子里找到的贝壳。

vocab.definition: to make
vocab.example: He forms a pot with his hands.
vocab.cn_example: 他用手形成一个罐子。

vocab.definition: to hit something with your foot
vocab.example: Lee kicked the ball to Henry.
vocab.cn_example: 李把球踢给了亨利。

vocab.definition: to stretch out the arm to touch or get with your hand
vocab.example: She reaches for the baby.
vocab.cn_example: 她伸手去够婴儿。

vocab.definition: to look at or study something again
vocab.example: The students review their notes for the exam.
vocab.cn_example: 学生们复习笔记准备考试。

vocab.definition: easy
vocab.example: He solved a simple problem.
vocab.cn_example: 他解决了一个简单的问题。

vocab.definition: a sport in which a ball is kicked into a goal to win a point
vocab.example: Soccer is a popular sport in many cultures.
vocab.cn_example: 足球在许多文化中是一项受欢迎的运动。

vocab.definition: a shape with a special meaning
vocab.example: A heart shape is a symbol of love.
vocab.cn_example: 心形是爱的符号。

vocab.definition: to let someone do something
vocab.example: Her parents allow her to have a strange hair color.
vocab.cn_example: 她的父母允许她染奇怪的发色。

vocab.definition: a flying animal that hunts at night
vocab.example: The bat returns to the forest to hunt for food.
vocab.cn_example: 蝙蝠回到森林中觅食。

vocab.definition: to move the body as a way to get healthy
vocab.example: They decided to exercise in the park.
vocab.cn_example: 他们决定在公园里锻炼。

vocab.definition: to make people do things they do not want to do
vocab.example: Wayne’s mom forced him to eat all of his meal.
vocab.cn_example: 韦恩的妈妈强迫他吃完所有的饭。

vocab.definition: the flat green part of a plant
vocab.example: Each kind of plant has unique leaves.
vocab.cn_example: 每种植物都有独特的叶子。

vocab.definition: a person in a group or club
vocab.example: All of the members wear the same clothing.
vocab.cn_example: 所有成员都穿着相同的衣服。

vocab.definition: actually happening; being what it looks like
vocab.example: He looks at the bill to see if it is real.
vocab.cn_example: 他看着纸币辨别是否是真钱。

vocab.definition: a flat board or paper with a message on it
vocab.example: Follow the sign to the international airport.
vocab.cn_example: 跟着标志走到国际机场。

vocab.definition: to move your foot up and put it down in a different spot
vocab.example: Sarah stepped on the stones to cross the river.
vocab.cn_example: 萨拉踩着石头过河。

vocab.definition: something nice that you do not eat or do often
vocab.example: They enjoy a treat after school.
vocab.cn_example: 他们放学后享受一份款待。

vocab.definition: feeling fear
vocab.example: Marta is afraid of bats.
vocab.cn_example: 玛尔塔害怕蝙蝠。

vocab.definition: good for everyone
vocab.example: They made a fair exchange.
vocab.cn_example: 他们做了一次公平的交换。

vocab.definition: to put all of your thoughts on one thing
vocab.example: He focuses on the yellow spot in the center.
vocab.cn_example: 他集中注意力看中心的黄色斑点。

vocab.definition: from a different country
vocab.example: Kate went on a journey to a foreign country in Africa.
vocab.cn_example: 凯特去非洲的一个外国旅行。

vocab.definition: something you do often, usually without thinking about it
vocab.example: Drinking soda is a terrible habit.
vocab.cn_example: 喝汽水是一个糟糕的习惯。

vocab.definition: to make something for the first time
vocab.example: Nathan invented a robot that can solve puzzles.
vocab.cn_example: 内森发明了一个能解谜的机器人。

vocab.definition: the words and symbols used by people of one country or area
vocab.example: I cannot read the sign. It is in a foreign language.
vocab.cn_example: 我看不懂那个标志。它是用外语写的。

vocab.definition: a country
vocab.example: Switzerland is a small nation.
vocab.cn_example: 瑞士是一个小国。

vocab.definition: not moving
vocab.example: The woman is very still.
vocab.cn_example: 那个女人非常安静不动。

vocab.definition: knowing the right things to do
vocab.example: My grandfather gives good advice because he is wise.
vocab.cn_example: 我爷爷给出好建议因为他很明智。

vocab.definition: a group of people watching an event or show
